findings.description: During the first airborne trick the board's underside, viewed from below with trucks and wheels clearly mounted on the camera-facing face, is solid black at 00:01.75-00:02.25, becomes plain natural/light wood at ~00:02.5 (trucks still on the camera-facing face), then turns dark/black again at 00:02.75. Because the truck side never rotates away from camera, a flip cannot explain the change: the bottom graphic of the same deck changes color with no visible cause.
